title: Emit the E-Document LLM calls under the Payables Agent copilot capability
summary: E-Document LLM calls that exist for the Payables Agent are now routed through the Payables Agent app and emitted under its copilot capability, at the dataplane's request to simplify billed feature management.
key_points: E-Document LLM calls used only for Payables Agent scenarios now run under the Payables Agent copilot capability
New Payables Agent codeunit PADraftBasedCopilotCaller makes these calls
E-Doc. AI Tool Processor and E-Document MLLM Handler updated for the routing
Requested by dataplane to simplify management of billed features
quote: Routing the calls done for the Payables Agent functionality that are done today in the E-Documents app via the Payables Agent app.
